name: Here's My Application! (Please Date Me!)
source:
After losing your job, you move back home. While job-hunting, you meet up with a few new people who can help you find a new occupation. Will you be able to find a new job back at home with all these distractions? 

[From [url=https://snatch-gaymes.itch.io/heres-your-application]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
失业之后，你搬回了老家。在求职过程中，你结识了几位能帮你寻找新工作的新朋友。面对这重重诱惑与分心之事，回到老家的你还能顺利找到新工作吗？

[引自[url=https://snatch-gaymes.itch.io/heres-your-application]Itch.io[/url]]
